verdict.rationale: Milvus is a vector database, and a database could plausibly offer user-defined scheduled jobs or triggers, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no capability for users to set up background automations. The only related item is automatic index building when a data slice fills (milvus-comm-2), which is internal engine behavior, not a user-configured automation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
